title: iPhone Cache Not Deleted
summary: Even though I have no Unread stories in NewsBlur, the NewsBlur app is currently taking 4.2GB of storage on my iPhone. That is more than any other app on my iPhone!!! How do I get NewsBlur to release/delete the space it is taking on my iPhone? NewsBlur should be cleaning up after itself, but it is not. Is there a function to release/delete the cache?
